# GenSpeak

> GenSpeak is a done-for-you YouTube agency for B2B companies and agencies,
> founded and run by Muhammad Muawaz. Clients film about 2 hours a month;
> GenSpeak handles everything else: channel strategy, video topic research,
> scripting, editing, thumbnails, YouTube SEO, short-form clips, LinkedIn
> posts, lead magnets, and email funnels. The goal is not views. It is
> qualified sales calls: GenSpeak guarantees 20+ qualified sales calls per
> month, or it refunds the fee and keeps working free until the target is hit.

## What GenSpeak does

- Done-for-you YouTube channel management for B2B service businesses
- Video strategy modeled on proven outlier videos in the client's niche
- Full production: scripts, editing, thumbnails, packaging, publishing
- Multi-platform repurposing: YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, X
- Conversion assets: lead magnets, opt-in pages, email funnels
- Booking and sales pipeline setup so videos turn into sales calls

## Who it is for

B2B expertise firms (tax, RIA, fractional CFO) and B2B growth agencies
(cold email, paid ads, AI automation) that want clients from YouTube
without becoming full-time content creators.
